body: LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
plain_description: Run any AI model — LLMs, vision, voice, image, and video — entirely on your own infrastructure, no GPU required. One self-hosted engine with drop-in OpenAI, Anthropic, and ElevenLabs API compatibility. Built-in user management, AI agents, fine-tuning, and distributed scaling — all while keeping your data private.
technical_description: LocalAI is an open-source AI serving engine that loads LLMs, vision, voice, image, and video models behind a single REST/gRPC API. The core is written in Go; each model engine (llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, diffusers, MLX, etc.) runs as an isolated gRPC process in C++, Python, or Rust, shipped as a separate OCI image and pulled on demand. It exposes drop-in OpenAI-compatible endpoints for chat, embeddings, audio transcription, TTS, image generation, and vision, plus Anthropic and ElevenLabs API compatibility. GPU acceleration covers NVIDIA CUDA 12/13, AMD ROCm, Intel oneAPI, Apple Silicon Metal, and Vulkan, with CPU-only fallback. The project includes distributed horizontal scaling with VRAM-aware routing via NATS and PostgreSQL, MCP-based autonomous agents with tool use and RAG, fine-tuning via TRL with auto-export to GGUF, on-the-fly quantization, PII redaction, voice recognition, face detection, and a React-based administrative Web UI with i18n.
title: LocalAI
